label: POC Onboarding: Import OS Build
mcp_tool_description: Import one image into an OS build and attach the build to the handler's environments, as the handler's images page does. onb_image is an AMI id or exact AMI name (AWS), a template name or publisher:offer:sku[:version] (Azure; the images must be cached, run Sync Images on the handler page if none are), or a template name (vCenter; cached by the 'Fetch and Cache available VMWare template' recurring job). An existing OS build with onb_os_build_name is reused, so call it once per handler with the same name and one blueprint deploys to both clouds. onb_environments limits the attachment (default: every environment of the handler); onb_region names the image's region or location when it cannot be read from the environments. Runs as a job: poll the returned id with fetch_job. Requires a CloudBolt admin caller.
